get.description:
The seeded demo mission package (Task 7.5): works with no network at all.

The client still sends it through POST /api/mission/import like any other package.

post.description:
Evidence Passport v2 (architecture 19.9, Task 6.9). The run is re-validated by the
schema; the budgets and the Phase 6 research evidence (traceability, Pareto position,
robustness, schedule) are recomputed here from its snapshot and the replay is re-checked
here, so the passport never relies on client-calculated results or a client claim of
identity.
Dependency graph plus STM/MTM tables for one design revision (architecture 19.1).
What one edit changed: metrics, constraints and science objectives (19.1 behaviour 7).

Validate an exported MissionPackage (architecture 13, 16). Body = the raw package JSON.

All-or-nothing: nothing is stored server-side and any failure returns an error envelope,
so the client replaces its saved state only on ok=true. Titles are sanitised by the
schema; the analysis is recomputed here (the exported one is derived, never trusted).
Candidate designs, the feasible Pareto front, archetypes and near misses (19.2).
Deterministic one-step improvements computed by the engine (architecture 19.8).

Replay a recorded run. `identical` is true only after comparing the re-run with the
recorded run (canonical JSON; numbers compare by value, as 275 vs 275.0 after a JS round trip).

Differing engine / catalogue / scenario / schema versions or a missing event set return
ok=true with status "version-mismatch" and no re-run: never a claim of identity.
Seeded Monte Carlo robustness proxy (architecture 19.3); default 250 samples.

get.description: A stored run (Mission Control reload). 404 once evicted; the client keeps its own copy.

post.description: Branch a stored run with one player decision. Returns a NEW run; the source is unchanged.
Which planned observations fit storage, energy, pointing and contacts (19.6).
Run one deterministic simulation (architecture 11.2). Never accepts a client analysis.
Compare 1-3 alternatives against a base design (architecture 11.2). Nothing is mutated.
Bayesian belief over scenario hypotheses plus the most informative next observation.
